title: Map interaction overhaul, country aliases, and founding member understanding
body:
MAP PERFORMANCE & INTERACTION OVERHAUL
- Restored native SVG vector paths for every country on the world map, bringing back country clicks, hovers, and tooltips.
- Optimized world and continental GeoJSON datasets, reducing map payload by approximately 65% for faster loading.
- Matched the map container background to the Esri ocean color (#232227) and increased default zoom for closer map framing.

SMARTER QUESTION ROUTING FOR FOUNDING MEMBERS
- Questions about organization founders, original signatories, or accession dates (such as EU founding members / Inner Six) are now routed to full historical knowledge rather than flattened into present membership.

EXPANDED COUNTRY ALIASES & ACRONYMS
- Added comprehensive Polish and English aliases for all 196 countries, including Micronesia (Federated States of Micronesia) and Czechia (Czech Republic).
- Standard country acronyms with or without periods (such as U.S., USA, U.K., UK) are now recognized accurately.

ANSWER REPORTING FOR CONTINENTAL CHALLENGES
- Players can now submit feedback reports directly from Europedle and other continental games, with reports correctly referencing the continental challenge.
